headline: Budget committee adjusts FY27 budget, passes property tax tier change 8-1, recesses to Monday

meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.voteItem: Motion to withdraw $2 million appropriation for assisting South Maui residents and small businesses
meeting.summary: The committee worked through the proposed fiscal year 27 budget, setting aside up to $9 million for Hoʻonani Village well and water work. It passed a non-owner-occupied property tax tier change 8-1 and will take up general budget provisions at 10 a.m. Monday.
meeting.recap: The one agenda item was the proposed fiscal year 27 County of Maui budget.[[0:02:14]] A member moved to set aside up to $9 million in excise tax funds for well and water work at the Hoʻonani Village project.[[0:41:13]] A motion set aside $1,184,375 for bargaining units 11 and 15 contract costs.[[0:45:26]] The bargaining unit motion passed with eight ayes and one member recused.[[0:54:07]] Staff said the general fund was short $10,848,100.[[1:08:14]] A member said changing property tax tiers for non-owner-occupied homes would raise $5,668,013 without changing rates.[[1:48:08]] The tier change passed 8-1 on a roll call.[[1:59:10]] The committee recessed until 10 o'clock Monday to take up general budget provisions.[[2:03:32]] There will be no public testimony Monday.[[2:04:09]]
decided: The committee withdrew $2 million meant for South Maui residents and small businesses affected by storms.
The committee cut $1 million in expected revenue from a revolving fund to offset $1 million for Kīhei Drainage Master Plan work.
The committee recommended referring Bill 61, on a fiscal reserve fund, to the budget committee for later.
The committee recommended first passage of Bill 62.
The committee recommended passage of Bill 64.
The committee voted to refer Bills 66 and 67 to another council committee.
The committee changed the funding for council office renovations from the general fund to bonds.
The committee cut $50,000 from environmental protection grants.
The committee voted to transfer the excess general fund balance to the open space fund.
The chair recommended sending Bill 76, on the water system development fee, to a water committee.
meeting.next: Chair Lee will take up the general budget provisions on Monday. The public can watch Monday and send comments by email or the e-comment link.
